description: This file defines the LoaderInterface in Twig, an interface that all loader classes must implement. It declares methods for fetching source context, cache key, freshness, and existence of templates.

classes.name: LoaderInterface
classes.description: An interface that all Twig loader classes must implement, defining methods for template source retrieval, cache key generation, freshness checking, and existence verification.

methods.name: getSourceContext
methods.description: Returns the source context for a given template name, throws LoaderError if not found.

methods.name: getCacheKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key for a template, throws LoaderError if not found.

methods.name: isFresh
methods.description: Checks if the template is fresh based on last modification time, throws LoaderError if not found.

methods.name: exists
methods.description: Checks whether the specified template exists.
